precedent.note: Protocol art. 25(5), now art. 27(5): a decision of the Court binds only the parties, and only in that case. In the English text it sits in the article on applications for revision.

courts.name: ECOWAS Community Court of Justice
courts.note: Established by Revised Treaty art. 15; its powers are set by Protocol A/P.1/7/91 as amended. Art. 15(4): its judgments bind Member States, Community institutions, individuals and corporate bodies. Protocol art. 19(2), now art. 20: decisions are final and immediately enforceable, subject to the Protocol's review provisions. Treaty art. 76(2): decisions on Treaty disputes are final, with no appeal. Art. 10(d) as inserted in 2005 lets individuals apply for human-rights relief. Mauritania is not listed as a member: ECOWAS says it withdrew in December 2000 but gives no day, and an entry without its end date would read as a current member.
